decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposal is considered acceptable, because of its position, design and appearance, would relate well to its site and would not be harmful to the living conditions of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  The development is in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan, and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines (2002).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is used).
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Informative:

If you commence work on the ground floor extension before you have completed the roof extension for which you received a certificate of lawfulness on 24 May 2005, you will invalidate the lawful development certificate for the loft extension.  As a result you will be liable to enforcement action which may threaten any loan secured against the property and may result in prosecution attracting a fine, if successful, not exceeding ?20000.  It is also likely to make the property difficult to sell.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to house.
